title: Admin, Cleaning & Finance Coordinator
description: Stayful | Full-time, fully remote | UK business hours THE BASICS Type: Full-time, fully remote Hours: 40 hours per week, Monday to Friday Rate: $5 per hour during the three month trial, reviewed to $6 per hour for the right person Availability: UK business hours, 9am to 5pm GMT/BST Contract: 3 month paid trial, then ongoing Start: As soon as possible Reference: STAY-CFC (must be included in your application) Please read before applying: this role requires availability during UK business hours, 9am to 5pm GMT/BST. From the Philippines that is 5pm to 1am Philippine Standard Time. If you are not available during these hours, please do not apply. ABOUT US Stayful is a UK based property management company. We manage around 60 short stay properties on Airbnb, ---------- and other channels on behalf of UK property owners. Most of our team is based in the Philippines and we operate fully remotely. We run as a group of three companies: Stayful Ltd, the main operating company Stayful Bookings Ltd, our booking agency Stayful Systems, our software company building tools for the short stay industry This role sits across the two property businesses. We are a small company. There is no layer of middle management, nobody looking over your shoulder, and nobody to pick up the pieces if something is left unfinished. That means real ownership, real influence, and real responsibility. WHAT THIS ROLE IS This role brings together two sides of the business that depend on each other. Cleaner management. Our cleaners and cleaning companies are not scheduled by us. Once a cleaner is assigned to a property they plan their own rota and report their cleans through our systems. Your job is to manage them: build the relationship, monitor what they deliver, hold them to standard, and step in the moment quality slips. Invoice verification and records. When a cleaner or contractor invoices us, you are the person who checks it against what was actually reported and completed before it is approved for payment. You are the last line of defence on every payment this company makes. These two functions sit together for a reason. The person managing the cleaners is the person who knows whether the clean happened, who did it, and whether the invoice matches reality. Nobody is better placed to catch an error, a duplicate or an overcharge. On top of this you will handle general company administration: staff rotas and records, payroll submission, and the day to day admin that keeps a remote business running. You will report directly to Martyn, our Director. WHAT YOU WILL DO 1. Cleaner management and performance Our cleaners have autonomy over their own scheduling. You are not assigning individual cleans. You are managing the people and the standard. Own the relationship with every cleaner and cleaning company on our books. They should know you, trust you, and come to you first when there is a problem Monitor performance continuously using completion reports, photos, guest reviews and guest feedback Give each cleaner performance feedback every week: what is working, what is not, and what needs to change Hold cleaners to standard even when they would rather not engage. Cleaners are busy and regular check ins are easy for them to avoid, so you will need to be persuasive, persistent and firm when the situation calls for it Raise problems directly, promptly and fairly, then follow up until they are genuinely resolved. Never let something slide because chasing it is awkward Track recurring issues by cleaner and by property, and fix the underlying cause rather than patching the symptom every time Keep a written record of every check in and every issue raised 2. Guest flexibility and cleaning policy compliance Work with cleaners to accommodate early check ins and late checkouts wherever possible. These affect guest experience and revenue directly, and are worth the effort to arrange Make sure our mid stay cleaning policy is followed: the cleans happen, on time, to standard Make sure our deep cleaning policy is followed: cleans are booked in, completed on time, and verified rather than assumed Verify completion through our systems and chase anything that has not been reported 3. Cleaner recruitment and onboarding Find, vet and onboard new cleaners and cleaning companies, both to replace those who leave or underperform, and to set us up in new areas as we grow Agree rates and terms, brief new cleaners fully on our standards, and set them up in our systems Maintain a pipeline of potential cleaners so that losing one is never a crisis 4. Weekly reporting to management Produce a weekly written report covering every cleaner: how they are performing, any issues and their status, and any opportunities you have spotted Escalate significant problems as they happen rather than saving them for the report. Management should never be surprised by something you already knew 5. Invoice verification and payment control Verify every incoming cleaning and contractor invoice before it is approved: correct supplier, correct property, correct date, correct rate, correct total Cross check every invoiced clean against what was reported and completed in our systems. If a clean was not carried out, it does not get paid Identify and challenge duplicates, double charges, rate changes that were never agreed, and invoices from suppliers we no longer work with Query discrepancies directly with the supplier and resolve them, rather than passing them straight up the line Log and process approved invoices through Apron and Xero Chase missing invoices so costs land in the right month and nothing arrives as a surprise 6. Financial records Keep income and expense records accurate, current and correctly categorised Maintain the cashflow records in Google Sheets and keep the Stayful Finance Dashboard up to date Flag discrepancies between the cashflow records, the invoices and the accounts as soon as you spot them Send Martyn a short written weekly summary: what has been processed, what has been flagged, what is outstanding 7. Rotas, payroll and company admin Keep staff rotas accurate and up to date, and arrange shift cover in advance rather than in a scramble Maintain team records: hours logged, leave, onboarding documents, contact details Prepare and submit payroll on time and correctly, checking hours and rates before submission rather than after Handle general company administration: document management, supplier records, filing and renewals Keep our processes and SOPs current, and write new ones where there is a gap WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR Three qualities matter more than anything else in this role. Attention to detail. You check things properly. You do not tick a box because a message was sent, and you do not approve an invoice because it looks roughly right. You compare it against what actually happened, and if the two do not match, you find out why. Problem solving. When something is wrong, you take responsibility for putting it right. You use your initiative and work the problem through. Asking for help when you are genuinely stuck is fine and encouraged. Handing every difficulty straight to someone else to solve is not. The confidence to hold people to account. You are comfortable being the person who chases. Our cleaners are busy and independent, and would generally rather get on with the job than take a weekly call. You will need to be persuasive and firm when firmness is what the situation needs, while keeping the relationship a good one. Both halves matter. Someone who cannot be direct will let standards drift, and someone who is only direct will lose us good cleaners. What will not work here is leaving things unchecked or unanswered, or quietly hoping a problem goes unnoticed. We would far rather hear about a mistake immediately than find it three months later in the accounts. Raising a problem you spotted is never held against you. Hiding one is. Essential Demonstrable attention to detail in work where errors have a real cost, with specific examples you can talk us through Experience verifying, checking or reconciling invoices, timesheets, payments or similar records Experience managing contractors, suppliers or field staff you did not directly supervise, including chasing them and having the difficult conversation when work is not right Strong written and spoken English. You will be speaking and writing to UK based cleaners and suppliers every day Organised and reliable with deadlines and reporting, across many properties and moving parts at once Comfortable with spreadsheets and digital tools, and quick to learn new systems Able to work independently and manage your own workload without daily supervision Available during UK business hours, 9am to 5pm GMT/BST. This is a firm requirement Desirable Experience in property management, short term rentals, hospitality or facilities Experience managing cleaning, housekeeping or maintenance providers Experience recruiting or sourcing contractors and negotiating rates Xero experience, or bookkeeping and accounts payable experience Familiarity with Apron or a similar invoice management tool Experience running payroll or managing staff rotas and time records Experience writing or improving SOPs and processes WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE The person who does well here will bring ideas to the table, not just complete tasks. If you can see a better way to monitor cleaner quality, a tighter way to check invoices, or a report that would give us visibility we currently lack, propose it and build it. We are actively bringing AI into how our team works so that a small team can do more, to a higher standard, in less time. We want someone curious about this and willing to use these tools to work smarter, not someone nervous of them. If you already use AI tools in your work, tell us how. Beyond the work itself, we want someone who is easy to work with and a pleasure to have on the team. We are a small group working remotely across time zones, so being straightforward, communicative and good natured matters here. This is a full time role from day one. The rate starts at $5 per hour for the three month trial, and we expect to review it to $6 per hour for the right person once that is complete. We are a growing group of companies, and people who show initiative here get the first opportunity when new work comes up. THIS ROLE IS NOT FOR YOU IF You are not available during UK business hours. This is a firm requirement with no flexibility You are looking for part time work, or you have other commitments that would prevent you giving this role a full working week You find it uncomfortable to chase people, push back on them, or have a direct conversation about work that is not good enough You need constant direction, or you escalate every problem rather than attempting to solve it first You would rather leave something ambiguous than ask the question that resolves it You want a narrow, single task role. This one covers cleaner management, finance checking and general admin Being accountable for the accuracy of payments feels like too much pressure TOOLS YOU WILL USE Uplisting. Property management system: bookings, calendars and cleaning records WhatsApp. Day to day communication with cleaners and contractors Xero. Accounting platform across both entities Apron. Invoice management and approvals, integrated with Xero Google Sheets. Cleaner records, cashflow records and supporting documentation Stayful Finance Dashboard. Our internal platform for cash position and financial data Connecteam. Rotas, time tracking and team records. You will log your own hours here and submit a matching invoice each Friday Asana. Task and project tracking. Your work should be visible here without being asked for Slack. Day to day communication with Martyn and the team Google Meet. Weekly check in with Martyn Claude (AI). We use AI across the business to work faster and more accurately. You will be trained and supported in using it HOW TO APPLY Applications are only accepted through our application form. Please do not send a message through OnlineJobs.ph. Applications sent that way will not be considered. You must include the reference STAY-CFC in your application. Applications without it will not be reviewed. Apply here: ---------- In your application, please tell us about: A time you spotted an error that others had missed, and what you did about it A time you had to push a contractor or supplier to improve their work, and how you handled it A problem you solved on your own initiative rather than escalating Generic applications will not be considered.

I need someone who already produces at a high level from day one — generating, judging whether an output is good enough, re-generating when it isn't, and assembling the final video in CapCut. I will give you my scripts, my reference videos and my style rules. You should be producing on day one with minimal direction. The process is fast and repeatable once you know the style. WHAT I NEED FROM YOU Proven hands-on experience with Google Flow / Veo 3 — generating photorealistic AI video from written prompts, clean vertical short-form, ready to post. Not "I use ChatGPT." I mean real work you can show me. Please include examples of your work. GPT Images and Nano Banana (1, 2 and Pro) — hyper-realistic AI image generation, and knowing when to use which. Character appearance, clothing and setting must stay consistent across every generation in a video. ElevenLabs for voiceover, timed so there is no dead air and no cut-off lines. CapCut — text overlays, font styling, music syncing, color grading and precise pacing. You can look at a reference video and replicate the editing style exactly, without being told every detail. An eye for when a generation is unusable — distorted hands, unnatural movement, a face that changes between clips. You catch it and re-run it. If a video has to be redone because my instructions were not followed, that is not a separate paid job. HOW TO APPLY Start your message with the word TURMERIC so I know you read the entire post. Send links to AI videos YOU created yourself. This matters far more to me than your resume. Tell me exactly which AI video, image and voice tools you have used, and for how long. Applications that skip these steps will not be read. Shortlisted applicants will get a small test video. Looking forward to seeing your work.

title: Labor Compliance Specialist/Auditor
description: Position Overview Veracity Compliance, Inc. is seeking a highly analytical, detail-oriented, and organized Labor Compliance Specialist / Auditor to support the review, auditing, and administration of labor compliance requirements for public works, federally funded, and other regulated construction projects. The ideal candidate must be able to follow instructions carefully, adhere to established workflows and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), maintain accurate and orderly documentation, and consistently complete detailed processes without skipping required steps. This is not strictly an administrative compliance position. We are specifically seeking a candidate with a strong auditing and accounting background who is comfortable reviewing payroll records, reconciling financial information, identifying discrepancies, documenting findings, and conducting detailed compliance reviews. The ideal candidate understands how financial records connect and has experience in auditing, accounting, Accounts Payable (AP), Accounts Receivable (AR), payroll, or financial reconciliation. Prior labor compliance or construction experience is highly preferred but may not be required for an exceptional accounting/audit candidate who can learn regulatory requirements quickly. A CPA, CPA candidate, or candidate with formal accounting/auditing credentials is strongly preferred. Key Responsibilities: Labor Compliance & Auditing Conduct detailed audits of contractor and subcontractor labor compliance documentation. Review Certified Payroll Reports (CPRs) for accuracy, completeness, and compliance. Compare payroll records against supporting documentation to identify inconsistencies or potential violations. Audit employee classifications, wage rates, fringe benefits, hours worked, overtime, deductions, and payroll calculations. Identify underpayments, overpayments, missing documentation, discrepancies, and other compliance deficiencies. Review payroll registers, timecards, proof of payment, canceled checks, direct-deposit records, invoices, and other supporting financial documentation. Calculate potential wage restitution and document the basis for audit findings. Maintain detailed audit trails and supporting documentation. Prepare clear audit findings, deficiency notices, and compliance correspondence. Follow up with contractors and subcontractors regarding outstanding deficiencies and corrective actions. Assist with internal and external compliance audits and investigations. Accounting & Financial Review Perform detailed reconciliations between payroll, accounting records, supporting documentation, and compliance submissions. Review AP and AR documentation when relevant to compliance verification. Trace transactions and payments through supporting accounting records. Identify mathematical errors, duplicate transactions, inconsistencies, missing payments, and unsupported amounts. Analyze spreadsheets and large volumes of financial information with a high degree of accuracy. Verify calculations independently rather than relying solely on information provided by contractors. Maintain organized records capable of supporting an audit, investigation, or agency review. Public Works & Prevailing Wage Compliance Depending on experience and assigned projects, responsibilities may include: California prevailing wage compliance Davis-Bacon / Davis-Bacon Related Acts Certified payroll auditing DIR requirements and eCPR WH-347 payroll review Prevailing wage determinations Fringe benefit verification Worker classification review Overtime requirements Apprenticeship requirements DAS 140 and DAS 142 documentation Apprenticeship ratios Restitution calculations Contractor and subcontractor compliance Agency and client audit preparation Labor compliance tracking systems and reporting Training may be provided on specific labor compliance regulations and systems for candidates with exceptional accounting and auditing qualifications. REQUIRED Qualifications Candidates must have professional experience in auditing, accounting, or financial review, including experience with Accounts Payable (AP), Accounts Receivable (AR), payroll, reconciliations, or similar accounting functions.

title: Virtual Assistant — Author Research & Email Outreach (Indie Book Publishing)
job_title: Virtual Assistant — Author Research & Email Outreach (Indie Book Publishing)
description: About us PageTurnerz is a UK-based book discovery platform. Readers tell us what they like to read, and we hand-match them to independently published fiction at no cost to the reader. We're building our catalogue and need help finding and contacting the right authors. What you'll do Research authors. Work from a defined list of sources (mainly Kobo's free and promotional ebook lists, plus Apple Books, Google Play and Barnes & Noble) to identify independently published fiction authors. Current priority genres: science fiction, thriller, horror, and YA. We already have plenty of romantasy and paranormal romance. Screen for eligibility. Check whether each author's book is exclusive to Amazon (KDP Select / Kindle Unlimited). Exclusive titles are not eligible and must be excluded. Full training and a step-by-step checklist are provided — this is the most important part of the role and it takes real care. Find contact details. Locate the author's publicly listed business email from their website, newsletter, or contact page. No scraping tools, no guessed addresses, no personal or private addresses. Maintain the tracker. Log every prospect in our spreadsheet: author, title, genre, source URL, email, date contacted, outcome. Send outreach. Send personalised emails from our approved templates in small batches of 10–12. Individual emails only — never BCC blasts or mail-merge blasts. Log and route. Record every reply. Forward interested authors to me. Add anyone who asks not to be contacted to the Do Not Contact list immediately. Report weekly. A short summary: prospects added, emails sent, replies received, problems hit. Rules you must follow without exception These are non-negotiable and I'll be checking: Never promise, guarantee, or estimate review numbers or outcomes. Never use the phrase "in exchange for a review" or anything close to it. Our reviews are invited, never required. Never quote prices. Pricing isn't finalised — route all pricing questions to me. No follow-up emails. One email per author. If they don't reply, we move on. Don't improvise claims about the platform. Use the templates. If a situation isn't covered, ask me. Only use publicly listed business contact addresses, and always record the source URL. We operate under UK GDPR and I need to be able to show where every address came from. What we're looking for Excellent written English — you'll be sending emails that represent the business to professional authors. Near-native fluency required. We use American English spelling throughout. Genuine attention to detail. The eligibility screening step has a specific rule set, and getting it wrong wastes everyone's time. Comfortable with Google Sheets or Excel. Reliable internet and consistent availability. A plus, not required: familiarity with self-publishing, Kindle Unlimited, Kobo, Goodreads, BookBub, or the indie author world generally. If you read a lot, say so. What you get from us A dedicated email account, the tracker, approved templates, and a written SOP. A paid trial period of [two weeks] before we commit to ongoing work. Clear, defined tasks. I'm not going to leave you guessing. How to apply Applications that skip these steps will be deleted unread. Use this exact subject line: READERS CIRCLE — [your first name] Complete this short task and include the answer in your application: Find one independently published fiction author whose ebook is available for sale on Kobo and is not enrolled in Kindle Unlimited. Send me: the author's name, the book title, the Kobo link, and one or two sentences explaining how you confirmed it isn't in Kindle Unlimited. Tell me in your own words — not a template — about any experience you have with research, list-building, or email outreach. Tell me the last book you read.

title: Social Media Poster - Christian Music App (2 hrs/day, Bonus on Views)
job_title: Social Media Poster - Christian Music App (2 hrs/day, Bonus on Views)
description: WHAT THIS JOB IS We are GodSounds, a US company. We built Odé Bible, an app that puts every chapter of the Bible to music - over 10,000 songs across every genre, from rap and country to worship and reggae. We need people to post short videos of those songs on social media. We make every video for you. You do not edit anything, you do not create content, and you do not need any design or video skills. Every morning a folder appears in your Google Drive with that day's videos and the exact caption to use. You post them, and you reply to the people who comment. If you know how to use Instagram and TikTok normally, you already have the skills. Everything else we tell you, step by step. WHAT YOU WILL ACTUALLY DO, EVERY DAY - Run 3 small music brands. Think of them like fan pages for a music genre, not personal accounts. Each brand lives on Instagram, TikTok, YouTube and a Facebook Page. - Post the videos we send you. Copy the caption we give you. That is it. - Reply to comments and messages like a normal person would. - Spend the rest of your time using the apps normally - watching, liking and following American Christian music accounts, so the algorithm learns who each page is for. THE SCHEDULE About 2 hours a day, 6 days a week. You choose your own rest day. - If you would rather work all 7 days, you can. - If you need a day off for travel or anything else, that is fine. Stack your hours: do extra on the days around it and schedule your posts ahead. Posts can be scheduled on every platform. Just tell us when you do it so your hours add up correctly. What matters is the total across the two weeks, not that you sit down at the same time every single day. You will need to work in the evening Philippine time (7-10 PM) or the morning (8-11 AM). That is when American audiences are awake. You can schedule posts into those windows and do the work whenever suits you. PAY - YOU CHOOSE YOUR TIER You pick one of three tiers when you apply. All three pay a fixed amount for each day you work, plus a bonus based on how many views your videos get. Tier A: $6 per day for the 2 hours, plus $0.50 per 10,000 views Tier B: $4 per day for the 2 hours, plus $1.50 per 10,000 views Tier C: $2 per day for the 2 hours, plus $2.00 per 10,000 views Those figures are for the whole 2 hours, not per hour. The daily rate is your floor - you earn it whether or not the videos do well. The bonus is where this gets interesting. We are looking for videos that reach hundreds of thousands or millions of views. A single video at 1,000,000 views pays $50, $150 or $200 depending on your tier. Views on all four platforms count. There is no cap on the bonus. Tier A is the safe choice. Tier C is the bet. Pick whichever suits you. After the first two weeks you may ask to switch tiers, subject to space being available in the tier you want. HOW AND WHEN YOU ARE PAID - You invoice every two weeks, and we pay by Wise. Wise only - it is free to set up and it is how our whole team is paid. - You are paid from your very first day, including the days you spend setting up and warming up the accounts. There is no unpaid trial, no unpaid test task, and no unpaid training. Every hour you work for us is paid. WHAT WE ASK A two-week commitment. By then you will know whether it suits you and we will know what a typical brand earns, and we will share those numbers with the team. After two weeks, if it is not for you, just tell us. No hard feelings. WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU - A smartphone (iPhone or Android) and reliable internet - Ordinary social media familiarity. If you use Instagram and TikTok, that is enough - Good written English. You will be replying to American commenters - 2 hours a day, 6 days a week - Honest, steady, and comfortable following a simple written process No experience with video editing or design is needed. If you have run a social media page before, that helps, but it is not required. WHAT WE DO NOT ALLOW No bots, no automation apps, no buying followers or views, no VPNs. The accounts have to be real accounts run by a real person, which is you. Anyone doing otherwise will be removed from the program. THE ACCOUNTS ARE YOURS You create the accounts with your own email and phone number and you keep them. We do not hold your logins and we will never ask you to hand an account over. HOW TO APPLY Email ---------- with this exact subject line, replacing the brackets with your own name: ODE FLOOD OJ - [Your Full Name] In the email, please include: Tiers: 1st ___ 2nd ___ 3rd ___ (A / B / C - only the ones you would take) Favorite genres: ___ (rap, worship, country, rock, R&B, reggae, folk, pop, gospel, 80s) Phone: iPhone / Android Best posting window: 8-11 AM / 7-10 PM (Philippine time) Your email for the Drive folder: ___ Have you run a social media page before? (yes/no - either is fine) And one last thing, in your own words: Tell us one Christian song or artist you genuinely like, and why. A sentence or two is plenty. We read every one of these, and applications without it will not be considered. Thank you. We are looking forward to hearing from you. - GodSounds, Inc.

job_title: Cold Caller / Appointment Setter (US Hours) — Must Sound American on the Phone
description: Cold Caller / Appointment Setter — US Hours — You Must Sound Almost Native American on the Phone We're Upwind, a US outbound calling agency. We make cold calls for software and AI companies and book qualified meetings for their sales teams. We're hiring remote cold callers / appointment setters right now. Read this part carefully — it's the whole job. The single most important requirement for THIS role is your spoken English. Our prospects are US business owners and decision-makers. We can only hire callers who sound nearly indistinguishable from a native American speaker — neutral American accent, natural rhythm, clean pronunciation, and a confident, easy phone presence. If you have a strong or noticeable accent, please don't take it personally — this specific role just won't be a fit, and we don't want to waste your time. Please be honest with yourself here. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Make 100–250 outbound dials per day on our dialer into US-based prospects - Follow a script while sounding completely natural, build quick rapport, handle objections - Qualify prospects and book appointments for the sales team - Keep accurate CRM notes and follow-ups - Work US business hours (night shift Philippine time), Monday–Friday WHAT YOU NEED - A near-native American accent and excellent spoken English (this is non-negotiable for this role) - Real outbound cold-calling / appointment-setting experience (US accounts preferred) - A quiet workspace, reliable high-speed internet, and a good noise-canceling headset - Resilience — this is high-volume phone work COMPENSATION $6.50 USD/hour + a bonus for every qualified meeting you book. Full-time, 40 hrs/week (roughly $1,127/month base before bonuses). HOW TO APPLY — follow these exactly, or we can't consider you: 1. Start your message with the word AMERICAN (all caps, on the first line) so we know you actually read this post. 2. Record yourself reading the short script below, word for word, and paste the link. Vocaroo is easiest — go to ---------- , hit record, read the script, and send us the link. This scripted recording IS the application — we listen to every single one. Applications without this recording are automatically declined. Script to read (read it exactly, in a natural US phone voice): "Hi, is this Mark? Hey Mark, this is [your first name] calling from Upwind — I know I'm catching you out of the blue, so I'll be quick. We work with software companies to book qualified sales meetings without your reps having to prospect. Real quick — are you the right person to talk to about your team's outbound, or is that somebody else? … Got it. Well, the reason I called is a lot of the founders we work with are great at closing but hate the top-of-funnel grind, so we take that off their plate. Would it be crazy to grab fifteen minutes this week to see if it's even a fit?" 3. Attach your resume. That's it. We read and listen to every complete application. Thanks — talk soon. — Tivan, Upwind

title: PART-TIME COLD CALLER – SAAS
description: Part-Time | 10 Hours/Week | Work From Home | $5/Hour + Commission We’re looking for a reliable, confident cold caller from the Philippines to help us introduce our software to US home-service businesses that use Thumbtack. ABOUT THE COMPANY SwiftReplAI automatically responds to new Thumbtack leads within seconds. Thumbtack leads often go unanswered because business owners are working, driving, or have their hands full. Our software helps them respond immediately so they have a better chance of winning the job. We’re an early-stage SaaS company, so your feedback will directly help us improve the script and sales process. If the campaign is working, there will be opportunities for more hours and increased earnings. WHAT YOU’LL DO • Make 80–100 outbound calls per day to US home-service businesses • Call during agreed-upon US Eastern Time business hours • Ask a simple qualifying question to find out if they use Thumbtack for leads • Have a short, natural conversation and listen to their response • Ask permission to text them a link to our free trial • Send the trial link using a provided template • Follow up with interested prospects when needed • Log every call in a shared tracking sheet For each call, you’ll record the outcome: • No answer • Voicemail • Not interested • Doesn’t use Thumbtack • Interested • Asked for more information • Trial link sent • Follow-up needed If someone says no, we also want you to record useful feedback about why they weren’t interested whenever possible. You will NOT be expected to aggressively sell or pressure people. The goal is simple: Find Thumbtack users → identify whether the problem is relevant → offer the free trial → send the link if they’re interested. WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR • Clear, easy-to-understand spoken English • Comfortable speaking with American business owners • Previous cold-calling or telemarketing experience preferred • B2B sales experience is a plus • Comfortable making a high volume of calls • Reliable internet connection • Quiet workspace and good headset • Available during an agreed-upon US Eastern Time schedule • Organized and able to accurately track calls • Comfortable hearing “no” repeatedly • Coachable and willing to improve based on feedback You don’t need to be an expert salesperson. We’ll provide the script, calling system, US phone number, trial link, and basic training. We’re mainly looking for someone who is comfortable talking to people, reliable, consistent, and willing to learn. PAY Starting pay: $5/hour Plus commission for every paying customer you generate. For now, you’ll be selling our $29/month plan. We also have higher-priced plans, but you will NOT be expected to sell those initially. COMMISSION STRUCTURE • 10% of the customer’s first month payment • 5% of their monthly payment for the following 12 months • Commission is paid only while the customer remains an active paying subscriber For a $29/month customer: First month: $2.90 commission Months 2–13: $1.45/month This means you can continue earning from customers you bring in even after the initial sale. If you consistently generate paying customers, your hours and earning potential can increase. TWO-WEEK PAID TRIAL We’ll start with a paid two-week trial period. Initial schedule: 2 hours/day × 5 days/week = 10 hours/week Target: Approximately 500 outbound calls per week During the trial, we’ll be looking at: • Number of calls completed • Quality of conversations • Number of interested prospects • Number of free trials generated • Number of paying customers • Call notes and feedback • Reliability and consistency • Ability to follow and improve the script We’re not expecting perfection during the first two weeks. We’re looking for someone who can consistently make the calls, have good conversations, learn from feedback, and produce results. If the results are promising, we’ll continue working together and can increase your hours and earning potential. THE CALL You’ll be provided with a short script. The conversation will start with something like: “Hey, is this Mike? My name’s [your name] with SwiftReplAI. Quick question — do you use Thumbtack for leads?” If they say yes: “When a new lead comes in and you’re in the middle of a job, how long does it usually sit before it gets answered?” From there, you’ll have a short conversation and, if they’re interested, ask permission to text them the free-trial link. The goal isn’t to give a long sales pitch. Ask the question, listen, and have a natural conversation. WHO WE SELL TO You’ll primarily be calling US home-service businesses such as: • Movers • Handymen • Junk removal companies • TV mounting companies • Cleaning companies • Other service businesses that use Thumbtack You’ll primarily be speaking with business owners or people responsible for getting new customers. Quick question — do you use Thumbtack for leads? ... When a new lead comes in and you’re in the middle of a job, how long does it usually sit before it gets answered?” Please also include: 1. 1–2 sentences about your cold-calling experience 2. Your availability in US Eastern Time 3. How soon you can start 4. Your preferred daily working hours Please only apply if you’re genuinely comfortable making outbound calls to US businesses. title: UGC Manager
description: I run a DTC ecommerce brand selling into the US market. Our growth engine is Meta ads, and we are investing heavily into UGC to feed it. We are building a library of genuinely good UGC, which means this job is mostly about judgment. Knowing the difference between content that will perform and content that just looks nice is the entire skill. The model is product seeding. Creators get the product free in exchange for content. The ones who deliver something that actually performs get moved onto paid work with us and that is where this gets interesting for you, because you will be the one d ---------- who graduates. Right now we get around 20 new creator applications a day, and there are 150 sitting in the queue I have not worked through. Every one of those is a potential video for the library, and every day I do not get to them is content we do not have. Here is the honest reason this seat exists. I am the founder. My time should be going into growth marketing, testing new angles, and scaling what already works. Instead a large chunk of it goes into filtering creator applications. That is work someone with good taste and a clear process will do better than me anyway, and I want to hand it over properly rather than keep half doing it. This is a long term role. I am not looking for someone for one project. I want to train one person properly and keep them for years. Why's this role is worth your time? Most UGC coordination jobs are pure admin. Send the brief, chase the creator, upload the file, repeat. This is not that. You will see the actual performance data on every video you approve. You will find out which of your picks made money and which ones died, usually within a few days. That feedback loop is the fastest way I know to learn what makes an ad work, and very few people get access to it this early in their career. You will work directly with me and a small remote creative team across a few time zones. We test, we look at the numbers, and we double down on what works. If you are good, this grows. More hours, more responsibility, more pay, and eventually input on the creative briefs themselves instead of just filtering against them. What will you actually do? Clear the 150 application backlog then keep the daily 20 from ever piling up again Run our creator campaigns end to end, from posting the campaign to receiving the final files Filter incoming creator applications and d ---------- who is worth sending product to Chase deliverables. Seeding only works if people actually send content back, and a lot of them will not without follow up. This is a real part of the job Review every piece of content that comes back against the creative brief. Approve, reject, or send back for revision Flag the hooks and angles worth cutting into more variations, and explain why Maintain the graduation list. Creators who deliver content that performs move from free product onto paid work, and you d ---------- who makes that jump Track delivery rates and performance by creator, so we stop guessing about who is worth the shipping cost Who I am looking for? Taste matters more than years of experience here. You should be able to watch a UGC video and know within five seconds whether it will stop a scroll, and be able to explain why. Beyond that: Some experience talking to creators or influencers. You have done outreach before and it went fine You can work without hand holding. I will build the process with you in the first week, then I want to stop checking Solid written English. You will be messaging creators directly on my behalf You have opinions and you will say them, including when you think a brief is weak Please do not apply if you need approval on every small decision. How to apply? Start your application with the word SCROLL so I know you actually read this. Then send me a short Loom video, 3 minutes maximum on your experience working with creators, if you have any. If you have none, say so and tell me why you would be good at this anyway. Loom is free at ---------- . Set the video to anyone with the link so I can open it. I am hiring one person. If you are not certain you are qualified but you know you have the eye for this, apply anyway.

Bonus - You have sold to US IT / security teams or to K-12 school districts. - You have touched MDM or browser management (Intune, Jamf, Google Admin, Group Policy). - You have done community-led or social selling: LinkedIn, Reddit, X, or niche forums, with results you can point to. - You have worked with LinkedIn prospecting tools (Sales Navigator, Apollo, Clay). title: Media Buyer - Meta
description: Facebook / Meta Ads Media Buyer — Lead Generation JT Media is a marketing agency that helps healthcare companies recruit new job candidates and generate qualified private-pay home care clients through digital advertising. We are looking for an experienced Facebook / Meta Ads Media Buyer to manage campaigns across multiple client accounts, develop and test new advertising angles, and consistently improve lead quality and cost per lead. Home Care Experience Is Highly Preferred If you have previously managed Meta Ads specifically for non-medical home care agencies, please make this clear at the beginning of your application and include examples of your results. Direct experience generating caregiver applicants, private-pay home care leads, or other types of leads for non-medical home care agencies is a major advantage and may qualify you for increased compensation. What We're Looking For We are NOT looking for someone who simply knows how to launch Facebook campaigns and make basic optimizations. We want a media buyer who understands direct-response marketing to cold audiences and knows how to systematically find new ways to generate qualified leads. You should be comfortable researching an unfamiliar market, understanding the target customer, identifying their problems and motivations, developing new angles and offers, creating ads around those ideas, testing them, analyzing the results, and continuously improving performance. You should genuinely enjoy the process of researching, creating, testing, analyzing, and finding winners. Your Primary Responsibilities Media Buying & Campaign Management Manage Meta advertising campaigns across multiple client accounts. Launch campaigns, monitor performance, optimize budgets and targeting, troubleshoot problems, and work to consistently improve lead quality and cost per lead. Cold Traffic Marketing Develop advertising specifically designed to convert people who have never heard of the client before. You should understand how messaging, offers, creative, targeting, and funnels work together when advertising to cold audiences. Market & Customer Research Research the industries and markets we advertise in to deeply understand the target customer. Identify customer personas, pain points, motivations, objections, desires, and triggers that can be turned into effective advertising. Angles & Offer Development Continuously search for new ways to position our clients' services. Develop and test new hooks, angles, messaging, offers, and concepts rather than relying indefinitely on existing winning ads. Creative Testing Build structured creative testing strategies and use AI tools to develop new static ad creatives and variations. You should understand why you're testing something, what variable you're testing, and what the results tell you—not simply create random variations. Audience & Funnel Strategy Build and manage appropriate audiences, including lookalike and retargeting audiences, and understand how targeting and funnels should change based on the stage of the customer journey. Performance Analysis Analyze campaign and creative performance to determine what is working, what isn't, and what should be tested next. We want someone who can turn advertising data into actionable decisions. Reporting Provide clear updates on campaign performance, creative tests, lead costs, results, learnings, and upcoming tests so our team always understands what is happening within our accounts. Team Collaboration Communicate consistently through Microsoft Teams, execute strategies developed with leadership, and proactively contribute your own ideas for improving campaign performance. Ideal Candidate You: Have proven experience managing Facebook / Meta Ads and can provide case studies or actual results. Understand how to generate leads from cold traffic. Understand direct-response advertising and lead generation. Know how to research a market and deeply understand the target customer. Know how to develop and test new advertising angles, hooks, offers, messaging, and creatives. Understand how to structure tests and use performance data to determine what to test next. Have strong knowledge of lookalike audiences, retargeting audiences, funnels, and Meta campaign structure. Have experience creating static advertising creatives using AI tools. Have strong written and verbal English communication skills. Have experience using Microsoft Teams or similar communication platforms. Are highly responsive during working hours. Have exceptional attention to detail. Have a reliable internet connection and computer. Strongly Preferred: Previous experience running Meta Ads for non-medical home care agencies, particularly caregiver recruitment and/or private-pay client acquisition. Experience with healthcare, recruitment, or other lead-generation campaigns is also valuable. Schedule Monday–Friday 9:00 AM–5:00 PM Eastern Time As JT Media continues to grow, there will be opportunities for increased responsibility and compensation. Payment Structure $250/week, paid weekly Candidates with significant, proven non-medical home care Meta Ads experience may qualify for higher compensation. How to Apply Please email or message us with: Your resume in PDF format. A short introduction explaining why you believe you're a strong fit for this position. Examples, screenshots, or case studies showing results from Meta Ads campaigns you've personally managed. A brief explanation of the types of businesses, offers, and audiences you've advertised to. Any experience you've had advertising for non-medical home care agencies. Please include specific results whenever possible. Relevant professional references we can contact (optional, but preferred). A screenshot of your internet speed test. Your preferred days and times for an interview, including your timezone. IMPORTANT: Begin your application with the word "MANGO" so we know you've read the entire job description and understand the position. Qualified candidates will be contacted to schedule an interview.

description: PPC Ad Specialist (Google Ads + Local Service Ads) Company: LIFT Auto Repair Marketing Location: Remote (Philippines) Type: Full-time Salary: $2,000 USD/month Schedule: Monday - Friday, 9am - 5pm MST (US Mountain Time) About LIFT LIFT is a US-based digital marketing agency that works exclusively with auto repair shops. We move fast, follow structured processes, and take responsibility for our work without being asked. This is a hands-on execution role with room to grow. We promote based on results and reliability. If you're the kind of person who gets better every month and takes initiative without being prompted, you'll do well here. The Role You'll manage a portfolio of 25-35 auto repair shop advertising accounts. You'll be inside Google Ads and LSA dashboards daily: optimizing campaigns, reviewing lead quality through call recordings, managing budgets, adding negative keywords, and building new campaigns from scratch during client onboarding. You'll work alongside 4 other PPC specialists and report directly to the Head of PPC. This is NOT a "set it and forget it" position. What You'll Actually Be Doing Campaign Management (Daily/Weekly): - Monitor and adjust campaign budgets to keep spend on pace with monthly targets - Proactively identify opportunities to increase budgets based on client goals and performance data - Review search terms and add negatives to eliminate wasted spend (solid grasp of negative keyword strategy and match types is expected) - Listen to and review call recordings and transcripts for lead quality - Check conversion tracking and flag/fix any issues - Run performance health checks on CPA, CTR, CVR, and CPC - Review and act on Google's optimization recommendations (only the ones that actually help) - Test new ad copy variations every 60 days - Manage geographic and ad scheduling targeting based on performance data - Log all activity for every account you touch What You'll Deliver - Campaigns that hit budget pacing targets without overspending or underspending - Clean, well-structured new account builds using LIFT's onboarding templates (Google Ads + LSA) - Negative keyword lists that eliminate wasted spend across your entire portfolio - Proactive flags when something is wrong (tracking issues, billing problems, underperforming campaigns) before it becomes a crisis - Clear, professional communication in ClickUp tasks and Slack every working day What This Role Is Not Be honest with yourself before applying: - If you need to be told which account to work on next, this isn't for you. title: Agency Account Manager
description: Clickvoyant- a fil-am owned business, is looking for an experienced Agency Account Manager to own the health, growth, and success of our client relationships. This person is the watchdog for the client inside Clickvoyant. Your job is to make sure our clients are getting what they were promised, receiving work on time, seeing clear value from our partnership, and never wondering what is happening with their account. You will sit between the client and our internal delivery teams, including project management, analytics, CRO, development, paid media, and creative. You are responsible for keeping communication moving, identifying problems before the client has to raise them, and making sure the work we deliver connects back to the client's business goals. This is not simply a relationship-management role. We are looking for someone who understands how agencies operate, can speak intelligently about digital marketing and website development, and knows how to identify opportunities to retain and grow accounts. What You'll Own Client Relationship & Communication Serve as the primary relationship owner for assigned Clickvoyant clients. Build trusted relationships with client stakeholders and understand their business priorities, concerns, and goals. Make sure clients always know what is being worked on, what has been delivered, what is coming next, and where decisions are needed. Respond quickly and professionally to client questions and concerns. Proactively follow up when a client goes quiet or when information is needed to keep work moving. Identify signs of dissatisfaction, confusion, or risk before they become account problems. Make clients feel supported, informed, and confident in Clickvoyant's work. Client Intake & Onboarding Lead or support new client intake and onboarding. Make sure client goals, KPIs, priorities, technical requirements, stakeholders, and expectations are documented clearly. Translate client needs into actionable requirements for internal teams. Confirm that access, analytics, platforms, websites, reporting, creative assets, and other dependencies are collected early. Establish clear expectations around communication, timelines, deliverables, and success metrics. Delivery Oversight Act as the client's advocate internally and make sure commitments are being met. Monitor account progress across project management and delivery teams. Follow up with project managers when deliverables, updates, or next steps are unclear or late. Escalate risks before deadlines are missed. Make sure work is not simply completed, but completed in a way that creates measurable value for the client. Maintain visibility into outstanding decisions, blockers, dependencies, and deliverables across every account. You are not expected to personally project-manage every task. You are expected to know when something is falling through the cracks and make sure someone picks it up. Account Growth Understand each client's business well enough to identify opportunities where Clickvoyant can provide additional value. Work with leadership and delivery teams to develop account expansion opportunities. Identify opportunities for additional services, testing, analytics, development, paid media, CRO, strategy, or related work. Help create the business case for account expansion using client goals, performance data, and identified opportunities. Participate in renewal and upsell conversations. Maintain a forward-looking growth plan for each account. The goal is not to sell clients services they don't need. The goal is to recognize where additional Clickvoyant work can materially improve their business. Retention & Account Health Own overall account health and identify retention risks early. Regularly assess whether clients understand the value Clickvoyant is providing. Make sure important wins, insights, results, and contributions are communicated clearly to client stakeholders. Identify accounts where value is unclear and work with the team to correct the issue. Surface risks involving scope, communication, performance, timeline, expectations, or stakeholder relationships. Support renewal planning well before contracts expire. What Success Looks Like A successful Account Manager at Clickvoyant: Clients rarely have to ask, "What's happening with this?" Deadlines do not quietly slip without someone noticing. Project managers are held accountable for communication and delivery. Client concerns are surfaced and addressed early. Clients understand the value Clickvoyant is creating. Renewals are planned instead of being surprises. Expansion opportunities are identified naturally through client needs. Leadership has a clear view of account health, risk, retention, and revenue opportunities. Clients see Clickvoyant as a proactive strategic partner rather than another vendor. Required Experience 3+ years of agency account management or client services experience. Previous experience managing multiple client accounts simultaneously in a marketing, digital, creative, ecommerce, development, or performance agency environment. Strong understanding of digital marketing and website development. Experience working with cross-functional delivery teams such as developers, marketers, designers, analysts, strategists, or project managers. Proven ability to manage client expectations, difficult conversations, deadlines, and changing priorities. Experience identifying account growth, renewal, or upsell opportunities. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Strong organizational skills and attention to detail. Ability to understand performance data and translate it into a clear client story. Comfortable holding internal teams accountable while maintaining strong working relationships. Strongly Preferred Experience in one or more of the following is a major plus: Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO) Ecommerce A/B testing and experimentation Analytics and GA4 Shopify Paid media Social media marketing Website design or development UX/UI Digital strategy Who You Are You're proactive. You don't wait until a client complains to investigate why something hasn't been delivered. You're commercially minded. You understand that great account management means protecting the relationship while also identifying opportunities to grow it. You're comfortable asking questions. If a project manager hasn't provided an update, you follow up. If a deliverable seems late, you investigate. If a client sounds unhappy, you don't pretend you didn't notice. You're client-obsessed without becoming a professional order-taker. You advocate for the client's goals while helping them understand what will actually produce results. You're organized enough to manage multiple moving accounts without losing track of commitments. Most importantly, you believe an agency should always be able to answer three questions about every client: Are we delivering what we promised? Are we creating measurable value? What should we be doing next to help this client grow? If those answers aren't clear, your job is to make them clear. To apply, fill out this application. ----------

title: Amazon PPC ,SEO, and Listing Optimization Specialist
job_title: Amazon PPC ,SEO, and Listing Optimization Specialist
description: We are hiring an experienced Amazon specialist who can connect PPC, SEO, and listing optimization. This role is responsible for finding performance opportunities, making or recommending changes, and monitoring whether those changes improve results. This is not an entry-level role or a copywriting-only position. Strong writing matters, but we are primarily looking for someone with hands-on Amazon advertising, SEO, data analysis, and listing optimization experience. About Zoniverse Zoniverse is an Amazon management and growth agency that works with established brands. Our team manages advertising, SEO, listing optimization, catalog operations, reporting, and account strategy. We are looking for a long-term team member who can take ownership of recurring performance work across multiple client accounts. How the Role Works PPC, SEO, and listing optimization affect one another. PPC data can reveal valuable search terms, weak traffic, and conversion problems. SEO data can reveal ranking gaps, indexing issues, and keywords that need more support. Those findings should influence main images, image stacks, titles, bullets, A+ Content, backend terms, and advertising decisions. You will be expected to explain what should change, why it should change, which data supports the recommendation, and how the result should be measured. Primary Responsibilities Amazon PPC Build and manage Sponsored Products and Sponsored Brands campaigns. Conduct search-term analysis and identify keyword, product-targeting, and negative-targeting opportunities. Adjust bids and budgets based on campaign objectives, conversion, ACOS, ROAS, placement, and available data. Monitor campaign performance and document the reason for meaningful changes. Use advertising data to identify SEO and listing optimization opportunities. Amazon SEO Conduct keyword research and map priority search terms to individual products. Monitor organic keyword rank, indexation, search visibility, and competitor movement over time. Use Brand Analytics, Search Query Performance, search-term reports, and rank-tracking data to identify opportunities. Investigate why important keywords are not ranking or improving. Recommend and monitor changes intended to improve organic visibility and sales. Listing Optimization Evaluate main images and secondary image stacks using CTR, conversion, customer intent, competitor positioning, and product benefits. Create clear creative briefs for main images, image stacks, A+ Content, and Premium A+ Content. Write and optimize titles, bullets, product descriptions, backend search terms, and A+ Content. Identify customer questions, objections, benefits, and use cases that the listing should address. Recommend tests and measure listing changes against a defined baseline. Separate traffic problems from targeting, click-through-rate, conversion, and organic-ranking problems. Workflow and Communication Manage work across multiple brands and ASINs without losing account-specific context. Maintain clear notes, change records, baselines, and follow-up dates. Update assigned tasks and communicate findings, completed work, risks, and next steps clearly. Collaborate with brand managers, designers, and other team members. Mandatory Requirements At least 2 years of hands-on experience managing Amazon PPC, SEO, and listing optimization within Seller Central. Direct experience creating and optimizing Sponsored Products and Sponsored Brands campaigns. Experience with keyword research, search-term analysis, organic-rank monitoring, and indexation checks. Ability to interpret PPC, Search Query Performance, Brand Analytics, keyword-ranking, CTR, and conversion data. Experience turning performance data into specific changes or recommendations for main images, image stacks, titles, bullets, A+ Content, and backend terms. Ability to establish a baseline and monitor whether PPC, SEO, or listing changes improved performance. Working knowledge of Amazon Seller Central, Amazon Ads Console, Brand Analytics, Search Query Performance, and a tool such as Helium 10. Proficiency with Excel or Google Sheets. Strong written English and the ability to explain decisions clearly. Ability to write and edit accurate, conversion-focused Amazon copy. AI may support the writing process, but you must be able to evaluate and improve its output. Experience working across multiple products, ASINs, or brands at the same time. Willingness to complete a practical skills assessment if shortlisted. Preferred Experience Previous experience working for an Amazon agency or managing multiple Seller Central accounts. Experience with Sponsored Display, Sponsored Brands Video, bulk operations, and Amazon advertising reports. Experience creating image briefs, A+ Content strategy, or Manage Your Experiments tests. Experience using ClickUp or a similar project-management system. How to Apply Begin your application with the phrase SEARCH FLYWHEEL so we know you read the full posting. Applications that do not follow the instructions below may not be reviewed. Provide your resume and a link to your OnlineJobs.ph profile. State how many years you have directly managed Amazon PPC, SEO, and listing optimization. Describe the number and types of Amazon brands or accounts you have managed at the same time. Share one specific example where PPC or SEO data caused you to recommend a listing change. Explain the data, the change, and the measured result. You may hide confidential brand information. Share one example of an Amazon PPC problem you diagnosed and the action you took. List the Amazon and third-party tools you have used regularly. Selection Process Application review Initial interview Practical Amazon PPC, SEO, and listing optimization assessment Final interview We are looking for someone who can study the data, make a sound recommendation, execute carefully, and return to verify the result.

title: SEO AND AEO SPECIALIST
description: We are a UK property management company hiring a dedicated SEO and AEO specialist to own search visibility across organic search, local search and AI search. The website is already built. Service pages, location pages, accommodation listings, booking system and payments are all in place. This is not a build role. Your job is to make what exists rank, get found, get cited by AI assistants, and generate enquiries. We serve two audiences through one website: landlords seeking property management, and guests booking accommodation. Both need to be found. You will implement on page and technical SEO changes directly in WordPress and work with a developer for larger builds. FIRST 90 DAYS You begin with a full assessment of where the site stands, then a prioritised plan agreed with the Director. 1. Technical SEO audit of both WordPress installations: indexation, crawl health, redirects, canonicals, duplicate content, architecture, internal linking, schema, Core Web Vitals 2. Content audit of every page: what ranks, what is invisible, what is thin or duplicated across locations, what to merge, rewrite or remove 3. Local SEO audit: Google Business Profile, citations and NAP consistency, map pack positions 4. AEO baseline: how we appear, or do not, in ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini and Google AI Overviews 5. Competitor benchmark: who ranks and who gets cited in our categories and areas, and why 6. Keyword and topic research producing a prioritised content plan 7. Reporting baseline in Search Console and GA4 Output: a written plan with priorities, expected impact and timeframes, approved before execution. RESPONSIBILITIES Technical SEO Fix indexation, crawl, sitemap and robots issues. Fix canonicals, duplicates, 404s and redirect chains. Manage site architecture and internal linking. Implement and validate schema (LocalBusiness, Organization, Service, FAQ, Review, Product, Offer, breadcrumbs). Improve Core Web Vitals with the developer, without removing conversion elements. Content SEO and blogs Own the content calendar. Research topics by search demand, competitor gaps and buyer questions. Write or oversee blog articles, guides, FAQs and location content matched to search intent. Rewrite existing pages to rank, and differentiate location pages so no two read as duplicates. Optimise titles, meta, headings, images and internal links on everything published. Local SEO and Google Business Profile Manage the GBP in full: categories, services, descriptions, photos, posts, Q and A, review strategy. Maintain NAP and citation consistency. Implement local schema and maps. Build local keyword strategy for service plus location and near me queries. Improve map pack positions and report monthly. AEO and AI search Structure content so AI assistants can extract and cite it. Build entity consistency across the web. Manage structured data, llms.txt and crawler access. Build third party mentions and citations. Track AI visibility and share of voice against competitors. Target featured snippets, People Also Ask and AI Overviews. Conversion support Find pages with traffic but no enquiries and diagnose why. Recommend changes supported by data, for approval before implementation. Tracking and reporting Maintain GTM and GA4 so forms, calls, WhatsApp clicks, bookings and calendar actions are tracked accurately. Own Search Console. Produce a monthly report: rankings, traffic, local positions, AI visibility, enquiries by source, next month priorities. WordPress implementation Implement on page, schema, redirect and content changes in WordPress and Elementor. Publish and optimise content pages. Coordinate with the developer on templates, performance and larger builds. HOW WE WORK Design specifications are final. Where a page design or template is supplied, it is not altered without written approval. Proposed changes to any approved page are submitted in writing with the reason and expected effect, and approved before being made. Work is complete when it is live, indexed where intended, and functioning. Drafts are not reported as complete. Delays, blockers and errors are raised as soon as known. Written weekly summary every Friday: what went live, what is in progress, what is blocked. Daily video call with camera on. Under 60 minutes response time during working hours. This is an exclusive full time role. No other employment or freelance work in SEO, content, web development or digital marketing during the contract. WHAT WE MEASURE Qualified enquiries from organic and local search, month over month Rankings on priority keywords in target locations Map pack positions How often we are named and cited by AI assistants Organic traffic to priority pages Content published against the calendar and how it performs Indexation health and error counts in Search Console Accuracy of conversion tracking REQUIREMENTS Essential 3 or more years in SEO with results you can evidence Strong technical SEO, able to audit and implement fixes Proven local SEO including GBP and multi location strategy Content SEO: research, briefing, writing or editing, optimisation Working knowledge of AEO and AI search visibility, or a clear plan to develop it fast Hands on WordPress and Elementor at the level needed to implement SEO changes and publish content without help Search Console, GTM and GA4 experience Fluent written English suitable for publishing Good documentation habits Desirable Property, hospitality, travel or local service lead generation experience Digital PR and link acquisition Looker Studio MotoPress Hotel Booking familiarity GoHighLevel familiarity Screaming Frog, Ahrefs or Semrush at an advanced level Content operations with AI writing tools under editorial control All paid tools are provided, including Ahrefs, Screaming Frog and Elementor Pro. HOW TO APPLY Applications missing any of the following will not be reviewed. 1. Your SEO experience: years, types of businesses, your specific role 2. Three SEO results you personally achieved: situation, what you did, measurable outcome. Screenshots from Search Console, Ahrefs or GA4 preferred 3. Written answer: a service business operates in twelve towns and wants to rank in all of them. How do you build and rank those pages without duplicate content, and what timeframe do you expect? 4. Written answer: how would you get a local service business named and cited in ChatGPT, Perplexity and Google AI Overviews? Be specific about what you would actually do 5. Written answer: you inherit a site with 200 pages built by someone else. What do you do in your first two weeks? 6. Written answer: describe a time a client or manager asked you to change something you disagreed with, and what you did 7. Two writing samples: one blog article and one service or location page you wrote or substantially rewrote, with the ranking or traffic result if known 8. Tools you use 9. Confirm you are available 10:00 to 19:00 UK time, Monday to Friday, with no other current work commitments Process: application review, video interview including a live screen share audit of one page, paid task for shortlisted candidates, offer. Independent contractor agreement under the laws of England and Wales. Three month probation. Performance and compensation reviewed every six months.
